{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders as they don't contribute to revenue
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
segment_channel_cross = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])

# Calculate revenue per channel, stratified by customer_segment
revenue_by_channel_segment = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Calculate the total revenue per channel (already done above, but confirm)
total_revenue_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

# Calculate average revenue per customer per segment and channel
avg_revenue_per_customer = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Show the results
revenue_by_channel_segment, total_revenue_by_channel, avg_revenue_per_customer"}
